_about: Narration for the launch video, one line per scene. `at` is the scene's span in scene.html's own timeline (seconds); voice.mjs stretches each span to fit its line. `|` marks a subtitle break and is not spoken; `say` respells words for the voice only. Styles are written in the narration's own language: a Chinese direction keeps Mandarin from sounding translated.

style.en: Friendly, clear and confident tech product narrator. Natural American English, conversational, medium-brisk pace, warm, never salesy.
style.zh: 自然、清晰、自信的科技产品讲解，标准普通话，像在给同行介绍一个好用的工具；语速中等偏快，语气友好温暖，不要播音腔。英文产品名照英文原样读。

scenes.en: Meet Kitfold: |one library for every coding agent.
scenes.zh: 这是 Kitfold，|一套技能库，管所有 Coding Agent。

scenes.en: Every coding agent loads skills its own way: |its own folders, shared folders, other agents' folders, |plugins, and settings that switch skills off.
scenes.zh: 每个 Coding Agent 加载技能都各有一套：|自己的目录、共享目录、|别的 Agent 的目录、插件，|还有设置里的开关。

scenes.en: Kitfold shows what each agent actually loads, |and traces every skill back to where it comes from.
scenes.zh: Kitfold 让你看清|每个 Agent 实际加载了什么，|每个技能都能追到来源。

scenes.en: One grid, every agent. |Click a cell to give a skill to one agent, |a few, or all of them.
scenes.zh: 一张表管所有 Agent。|点一下格子，就能把技能|给一个、几个，或者全部 Agent。

scenes.en: You can even hide a skill from just one agent |when it lives in a shared folder. |Kitfold writes that agent's own setting, |and only that entry changes.
scenes.zh: 就算技能放在共享目录里，|也能只对一个 Agent 隐藏。|Kitfold 写的是那个 Agent 自己的设置，|只改那一条。

scenes.en: Every change is previewed first, backed up, |checked right before writing, and journaled, |so you can undo any of it.
scenes.zh: 所有改动都先预览；|写入前先备份、再核对，|每次都记日志，随时可以撤销。

scenes.en: Profiles bring reusable instructions, and their skills, |into each agent's own file.
scenes.zh: Profile 是可复用的指令，|会带上它的技能，|写进每个 Agent 自己的文件。

scenes.en: And the same core powers the kitfold command line.
scenes.zh: 同一套核心，|也驱动着 kitfold 命令行。

scenes.en: Kitfold is free and open source. |Get it on GitHub.
scenes.zh: Kitfold 免费开源，|现在就去 GitHub 看看吧。
